blocks.text: User roles control access to features and actions within the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform). After creating users in your account, you can assign roles to define their access and permissions within the system.
You can assign either system roles or custom roles:

blocks.item: System roles are predefined by the Agentic SecOps Platform and cannot be modified. These roles are maintained by the system and are updated automatically when new features are introduced. To learn more, see Understanding System Roles.

Custom roles are created and managed by an admin. These are roles configured specifically in your account to meet organizational requirements. When new system features are introduced, related permissions must be manually added to custom roles. To learn more, see Creating Custom Roles.

blocks.text: When managing roles, you can perform the following actions:

blocks.item: You can assign a role to users to grant them specific permissions and access within the system.
To assign a role to users:
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click the Profile menu in the top navigation bar.
In the left-side navigation, go to Permissions > Roles.
Hover over the role and click the Edit Users icon (), or select the checkboxes next to the role and click Edit at the top of the page.
On the Edit Role page, click Add Users.
In the Add Users window, select the checkbox next to the users, then click Add.
Assigned roles are applied on the user's next browser refresh.
You can edit a user's role to update their permissions and access, either individually or for multiple users at once.
To edit a single user's role:
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click the Profile menu in the top navigation bar.
In the left-side navigation, go to User Management.
Hover over the user and click the Edit icon, or select the checkbox next to the user and click Edit at the top of the page.
In the Roles section, select the role you want to assign from the drop-down menu.
Select the checkboxes next to the users you want to edit roles for.
Click the Edit Role drop-down menu, and select the role you want to assign to the selected users.
Assigned roles are applied on the user's next browser refresh.
You can remove a user from a role to revoke their associated permissions while maintaining their access to the system.
To remove a user from the role:
In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click the Profile menu in the top navigation bar.
In the left-side navigation, go to User Management.
Hover over the user and click the Edit icon, or select the checkbox next to the user and click Edit at the top of the page.
In the Roles section, select No Access from the account drop-down menu.

When removing a user's role without assigning them a new role, the user is automatically assigned the default role. While the default role grants no permissions within the account, it preserves the user's access to the system, enabling the option to assign a new role in the future.
